name: Jellyfin
description: Stream your own movies, shows and music to any device.

fields.label: Media folder
fields.help: Where your media lives on the device. It is created if missing; add this folder as a library in Jellyfin.

name: Vaultwarden
description: A password manager that works with the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions.
note: Bitwarden needs a secure (HTTPS) address, so it can only be published through Cloudflare, not on the local network.

fields.label: Public address
fields.help: Optional. The address you reach it at, without https://, for example myserver-vaultwarden.example.com.

fields.label: Allow new accounts
fields.help: Leave on until your own account exists, then turn it off.

name: Uptime Kuma
description: Watch your websites and services and get told when one goes down.
